basic_info.description: Outstanding 3-bedroom, 2-bath light-filled condo all on one level. Excellent floor plan features spacious living room with fireplace and deck, dining area, kitchen with granite counters and stainless-steel appliances. Fabulous light-filled master suite with beautiful completely renovated bathroom featuring a custom large walk-in shower. Two additional bedrooms, 2nd full bath, laundry hook-ups in laundry closet. Extra storage room located on deck. Excellent closet space. One-car parking. Well maintained building with 24-hour doorman/security and beautifully landscaped grounds. Great location, right across from Stern Grove. Walk to West Portal Village, short drive to Stonestown shopping mall, close to public transportation. Dues are $1,318.33/mo.
